notes: Checked on gov.bc.ca 2026-10-30: the pause stands. citations.quote: prior to the March 2023 decision, the Ministry considered cloud computing services (such as software as a service, remote storage and computing capacity) to be either the right to access taxable software programs, a taxable telecommunication service, or both.
